name: Kite Watcher Derek

intro.text: Shh! Seventeen kites over Kilham this morning. Eighteen if you count the one I've got in my team.

win: Outflown. A new tick for the notebook: beaten by a passer-by.
after: Red kites will pinch washing off the line to build their nests. Pants, socks, a teddy once. Lock up your smalls.
